parameter_locations.target_annual_vol_usage: analytics/strategy/lane_b_backtester.py:63 (declared); NOT applied to position sizing in current backtester logic — declared-only gap (BL-505e)

data_sources.point_in_time_marker: Publish Date column (simfin bulk v1 PIT convention; restatements ignored — see lane_b_backtester.py:23-24)

sample_window.rationale: CPCV (n_groups=6, n_test_groups=2) per ADR-017 honours chronological order via purgedcv CombinatorialPurgedCV; the explicit train/validation split pins the OOS reporting region (validation 2024+) so future re-runs cannot shift the window silently.

qualification_protocol.n_trials_rationale: No parameter search is run for this variant; n_trials=1 (the canonical, conservative case where the DSR degenerates to the PSR). Discovery sweep counts belong to OTHER variants (BL-OPC-12 reported 8 trials across the config family; that family is NOT the variant under pre-registration here).
qualification_protocol.returns_matrix_for_pbo: single-row variant returns matrix shape (1, n_periods) — PBO is undefined for a single variant and is reported as None; the variant's robustness is judged by CPCV OOS median + DSR + haircut SR alone.

pre_registered_thresholds.bear_2022_rationale: The bear 2022 subwindow is a SECONDARY gate: the variant must not lose money in a real bear regime (Sharpe > 0 is the minimum, justified by the BL-OPC-12 finding of 0.05 Sharpe on the composite default — anything <= 0 means the variant is worse than doing nothing). Full DSR/PBO thresholds are NOT applied to the bear slice because of its small sample (252 trading days is borderline for the statistical machinery).

pre_registered_thresholds_rationale: DSR/PSR/PBO from ADR-017 (DSR >= 0.95, PSR >= 0.95, PBO < 0.5 frozen there) — this pre-registration tightens PBO to < 0.20 because BL-OPC-12 found 0.635 on the full family (not the variant), and a stricter bar is needed to actually close the overfitting hole. Haircut SR > 0.50 mirrors ADR-019 'Lane B Sharpe target >= 0.5' after the multiple-testing + non-normality penalty (BL-707 / BL-KB-99). CPCV OOS Sharpe median > 0.50 is the honest out-of-sample equivalent. IC screen thresholds (ICIR > 0.05, block-bootstrap t > 2.5, 30% haircut) are pinned by the Edge Research Factory design spec (docs/plans/2026-08-21-edge-research-factory-design.md §6, BL-706). Bear 2022 Sharpe > 0 is the absolute floor — anything <= 0 means the variant would have been net-destructive in a real bear market and is not promotable to paper.
anti_harking_clause: All thresholds in this manifest were fixed BEFORE observing the qualification run's results. Any modification of thresholds after seeing results is FORBIDDEN; the only acceptable post-result action is to declare the variant REJECTED and re-open BL-726 with a new manifest version (schema_version bump).
clean_tree_clause: The working tree MUST be clean at qualification time (no uncommitted modifications in any path that affects the qualification: analytics/strategy/, analytics/research/, analytics/qualification/, analytics/metrics/, analytics/fundamental/simfin_loader.py). The HEAD commit hash recorded above MUST equal `git rev-parse HEAD` immediately before the qualification run. Any drift invalidates the manifest and the run is rejected.
open_gaps: target_annual_vol=0.40 is declared in LaneBBacktestConfig but the backtester does not currently apply volatility-target sizing (declared-only). The pre-registration is honest about this: the variant uses the composite screen with per-idea stop-loss; position sizing is equal-weight, not vol-targeted. This is BL-505e work that must complete before the live paper-promotion gate (BL-732). The qualification (BL-727) runs on the current code, not on the vol-target implementation.
SimFin Publish Date is used as the PIT marker; restated statements are NOT handled (lane_b_backtester.py:23-24). This is a known PIT gap documented at BL-619 scope.
